{{Quote|This 100,000 credit voucher is yours to use as you see fit, as long as you join the Alderbathe Monastery for life and give it all to them. Love, Grandpa.|A note from the grandfather to their grandchild|<ref name="HR">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>}}
An '''individual''' was the [[Gender/Legends|grandfather]] of another person who was active at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The grandfather once bequeathed a [[credit voucher]] of one hundred thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to their grandchild.<ref name="HR" />
